## Episode Overview

In this episode of *Sample Space: Random Talks*, we feature a candid conversation with Anqi Sui and Leandra Brauninger, two PhD students from the Department of Statistical Science at UCL. The discussion centers on the lived experiences of managing physical and dynamic disabilities within an academic setting.

::: {.callout-note icon="false"}

## Discussion Highlights

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### <i class="fa-solid fa-wheelchair"></i> Physical Accessibility
The interview highlights the tangible barriers faced during daily commutes and navigating the physical campus environment at UCL.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### <i class="fa-solid fa-brain"></i> The Mental Load
Anqi and Leandra discuss the compounded administrative burden of managing health requirements alongside intensive PhD research.
:::

:::

> "Community support networks are not just a nice-to-have—they are a critical component of academic infrastructure for disabled students."
